# Newark Heating & Cooling

> Residential heating and cooling service for Newark and all of Licking County, Ohio: furnace repair and replacement, heat pumps, central air conditioning, ductless mini-splits, seasonal tune-ups and 24/7 emergency no-heat service.

## Contact

- Phone: (740) 527-0222 (answered 24/7 for heating and cooling emergencies)
- Website: https://newarkheatingandcooling.com
- Service area: Newark and all of Licking County, Ohio

## Services

- [Furnace Repair](https://newarkheatingandcooling.com/furnace-repair.html): No heat, short cycling, strange noises or a furnace that runs but blows cold air.
- [Furnace Replacement](https://newarkheatingandcooling.com/furnace-replacement.html): Right-sized gas, propane and electric furnaces installed with the permit pulled for you.
- [24/7 Emergency Service](https://newarkheatingandcooling.com/emergency-hvac.html): No heat on a January night. Call any hour and you reach a person, not a voicemail.
- [Heat Pumps](https://newarkheatingandcooling.com/heat-pumps.html): Cold-climate and dual-fuel heat pumps, repaired and installed for Ohio winters.
- [AC Repair](https://newarkheatingandcooling.com/ac-repair.html): Warm air, frozen lines, a unit that hums but will not start. Fixed right the first time.
- [AC Replacement](https://newarkheatingandcooling.com/ac-replacement.html): New central air sized with a real load calculation, not a guess from the old unit.
- [Ductless Mini-Splits](https://newarkheatingandcooling.com/ductless-mini-splits.html): Heat and cool additions, finished attics, garages and older homes with no ductwork.
- [Tune-Ups & Maintenance](https://newarkheatingandcooling.com/hvac-maintenance.html): Fall furnace and spring AC tune-ups that catch the small problems before they strand you.

## Key facts

- Repairs are priced before any work begins; replacement estimates are free, written and itemized.
- New systems are sized with a load calculation.
- Works on all major brands and on natural gas, propane and electric systems.
